'''''Fighter''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was created by the mysterious and outspoken [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Ob Khaddor]], who disappeared shortly after a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] was placed on his head by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. ''Fighter''{{'s}} appearance and style were similar to ''[[Feared]]'', another painting created by Ob Khaddor. The painting was [[red]] hued and depicted a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] looking surprised, with vertical [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering on the left side. The lettering spelled out the word "Fighter."<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Fighter'' was one of the items available through the "rare loot system" in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The system allowed for a chance of extra, rare loot to drop from any enemy, with the loot increasing in value the more difficult the enemy was to defeat. The name of the creating artist is spelled Ob Khaddar in the item's description.<ref name="SWG" />
